_comment: Accepted codegen-differential defects, per (component, attribute, platform, check). An entry means the converter demonstrably fails that judgement and the failure is accepted FOR A STATED REASON — not that it is fine. Unrecorded defects fail `jui conformance gate --codegen-effect`; entries the measurement no longer supports are stale and fail too, so fixing a defect forces its row out (the one-directional version lets a fixed row sit here forever, which is how the previous freeze ledgers rotted). Advisory classes (value-is-default, numeric-string-divergence) are re-derived every run and are deliberately absent. Reason 'unreviewed-initial-measurement' marks the initial-measurement backlog — consume it.

entries.owner: kjui_tools: ticket kjui-indicator-style-loses-to-a-declared-wrapcontent, for the release after 1.9.0
entries.reason: indicatorStyle is declared for Compose from 1.9.0 (before, swift only, so android was not probed). kjui lets any declared width / height beat the style's size, and the fixture's Indicator declares wrapContent, so large and small both draw the default spinner; iOS and web read the style there. Not a change from 1.8.120: the same rule decided the legacy `style` size. Found after the 1.9.0 freeze; the user's ruling sends such differences to the next release.
entries.note: Fix: a wrapContent width / height is the content's size, and the style sets the content's size — only a length should win.

entries.owner: kjui_tools: ticket kjui-a-containers-tintcolor-reaches-no-descendant-control, for the release after 1.9.0
entries.reason: Ruling f5e6a502 (1.9.0): tintColor is the accent of the operable parts, never the text colour, so kjui dropped the LocalContentColor wrapper that coloured descendant text. A View has no operable part of its own, so Android now emits nothing for it; sjui emits .tint, which reaches a descendant control. Found after the 1.9.0 freeze; the user's ruling sends it to the next release.
entries.note: Fix: hand a container's tint down to the controls below it (their own tintColor wins), as .tint does on iOS.

entries.owner: kjui_tools: ticket kjui-a-containers-tintcolor-reaches-no-descendant-control, for the release after 1.9.0
entries.reason: The bound form of the same: with nothing emitted for a View's tintColor, the binding has nowhere to go (see the C0 row).
